upload_description_plain:
This is the song I should have turned in for the Secret Mixer.
But I started this the day before the deadline and couldn't get
past the piano section. 

You can consider it a remix of Smile (For A Bit) since they share
musical similarities. Except for the string section and the (what
I consider) tropical feel to this song, of course.

The full title of this song is 'The First Sunny Sky (In A Long Time).'

I hope you enjoy it.

upload_description_plain:
One day I was playing around with GarageBand, and realized that I had a melody in mind. I recorded it, put some lyrics on it, and this came out of it. I sing the song in Spanish, but then I do so in English. The part in English, I think is my favorite. Feel free to cut, copy, paste, accelerate the tempo, in whichever way you feel like. Hope you enjoy it and you have some fun with it. Please, do let me know what you come up with. Best regards!

Bailemos Together

Vocal Melody and Lyrics by Hidalgo Antonio

Vamos, bailemos juntos
la noche es joven
y no hay más
que desear, 
Porque en San Juan
podremos vivir;

Toda una feria tropical.
ya el sol se esconde bajo mi piel;

Ahora le siento consumir
Es la pasión que llevo de ti.

Let’s go, let’s dance together
The night just started 
Just rejoice
the eternal summer, 
San Juan is always up for fun …
 
I am a teaser,
And you should know;
My battle’s up,
It’s just begun.

Oh let me guide you through my attempt,
I’ll give you rapture
Just show me faith.
